title: Improvements to Jacobian Arithmetic in Global Function Fields
summary: We present two improvements to arithmetic in the Jacobian of global function fields based on the approach of Hess. The first reduces the number of expensive reduction steps by optimizing for typical inputs rather than worst-case behavior, assuming the function field contains a degree-one place. The second introduces a memory-time trade-off that speeds up computations by caching frequently used intermediate results.
